_note: S334 (audit items 9 and 13). The site has three clusters where several surfaces answer overlapping questions and none of them says how it differs from its neighbours: membership/identity (8 surfaces), editorial (8 surfaces), and evidence (handled separately by /evidence/). This file states, for each page, what it IS in one line and which sibling to use instead when the visitor wants the other thing. It is orientation, not navigation — the site nav still routes; this stops a visitor landing on the wrong one of three near-identical doors and bouncing. Every href is resolved against the tree at build time.
